$comment: LOCKED -- the approved screen-recording LOOK for this series. Reproduce it. Do not re-tune the camera, the chrome or the choreography to fix something else. A change needs approval FIRST, and both the change and the reason recorded here and in TAKES.md. This file exists because re-anchoring the final beat to suit the notify cue silently reframed the approved take and cut its payoff off.

measured_against_the_hand_made_reference.holds: dead still; the reference measures 0.00 frame-to-frame difference

deliberately_NOT_locked.duration_sec: varies with how long that skill's transcript takes; the take ends 1.2s after its own deliverable
deliberately_NOT_locked.notify_sec: measured per run; it never changes the picture

final_beat: Frames the WHOLE terminal, bottom-aligned with a small margin. The terminal is a fixed-height window whose content fills top-down, so framing all of it guarantees the artefact the run produced is on screen without chasing it -- and the install command and the command being run stay above it. X IS NEVER ADJUSTED: shifting sideways to keep a long file path whole pushes the command itself off the left edge, trading what the episode is about for what it ends on. A long path may run off the right, as it does in the hand-made reference.
